title: Manhunt - Real-Life GPS Game
short_description: Outdoor real-life Manhunt game with live seeker radar and periodic runner pings.
full_description:
Step into the ultimate outdoor pursuit game! Manhunt brings the classic childhood chase into the modern era with tactical GPS radar, stealth mechanics, and team gameplay.

🎯 SEEKERS VS 🏃 RUNNERS
• Seekers hunt with live, continuous satellite telemetry to track down the fleeing team.
• Runners must outsmart and evade their pursuers! Their positions are hidden in stealth, broadcasting a brief radar ping only every 5 minutes (fully customizable).
• Grace Period: Runners get a head start countdown to scatter into position before Seekers are released!

⚡ ZERO ACCOUNTS, ZERO SUBSCRIPTIONS
• 100% Free Forever: No paywalls, no credits, no paid server requirements.
• Instant Room Codes: Just enter a 4-letter room code (e.g. HUNT) with your friends and start playing across Android and iOS.
• Zero External Installations: Every setting, rule, and timer is configurable directly inside the app.

🛡️ TACTICAL THEMES & SENSORY HUD
• 5 Dynamic Visual Themes: Tactical HUD (Night Vision), Midnight Stealth (OLED Battery Saver), Cyberpunk Neon, Daylight High-Visibility, and Forest Camo.
• Proximity Alarms: Device vibrates and pulses audio cues when a pursuer enters your perimeter.
• Built-in Compass & Distance Indicator: Real-time bearing and meter distance to your nearest rival.

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST & PRODUCTION SAFE
• GPS data is strictly ephemeral and used only during active live rounds.
• No tracking when the app is closed, no account registration, and zero third-party data selling.

Get outside, gather your squad, and experience the thrill of real-world tactical evasion!

permissions_declared.purpose: Accurate real-time GPS coordinates to calculate proximity between Seekers and Runners on the interactive map.
Permits periodic runner ping snapshot updates when the device is locked in a player's pocket during active running rounds.
Maintains persistent session state and prevents Android from killing the match timer during outdoor chases.
Provides tactical haptic feedback when opponents enter within proximity alarm range.
